MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (this "Agreement" or this "NDA") is entered into at Mumbai on 14th September, 2026 (the "Effective Date")

BY AND BETWEEN

Brightwater Retail Solutions Private Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at 9th Floor, Coral Crest, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400051 (hereinafter referred to as "Brightwater", which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context, include its successors and permitted assigns);

AND

Pixelkraft Design Studio LLP, a limited liability partnership registered under the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008, having its registered office at Office No. 204, Shivneri Arcade, Karve Road, Kothrud, Pune, Maharashtra 411038 (hereinafter referred to as "Pixelkraft", which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context, include its successors and permitted assigns).

Brightwater and Pixelkraft are hereinafter individually referred to as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties". A Party disclosing Confidential Information under this Agreement is referred to as the "Disclosing Party", and a Party receiving it is referred to as the "Receiving Party".

WHEREAS the Parties wish to explore a potential business engagement under which Pixelkraft may redesign the customer-facing e-commerce website and mobile applications of Brightwater (the "Purpose"), and in connection with the Purpose each Party may disclose to the other certain confidential and proprietary information.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants set out below, the Parties agree as follows:

1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Confidential Information" means any and all information, in whatever form or medium, disclosed or made available by or on behalf of the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether before, on or after the Effective Date, and whether or not marked, designated or otherwise identified as confidential, including without limitation business plans, customer data, pricing, product roadmaps, source code, designs, wireframes, prototypes, know-how, and any information that the Receiving Party may learn or observe during visits to the premises of the Disclosing Party.
1.2 "Representatives" means, in relation to a Party, its directors, partners, employees and professional advisers and, in the case of Brightwater only, also its Affiliates, vendors and consultants.
1.3 "Affiliate" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a Party, where "control" means the ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting securities of an entity or the power to direct its management.

2. EXCLUSIONS
2.1 The obligations of confidentiality under this Agreement shall not apply to information which the Receiving Party can demonstrate by contemporaneous written evidence: (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party or its Representatives; or (b) was lawfully in the possession of the Receiving Party, free of any obligation of confidence, before its disclosure by the Disclosing Party.
2.2 The burden of proving that any information falls within an exclusion in Clause 2.1 shall be on the Receiving Party.

3. OBLIGATIONS OF THE RECEIVING PARTY
3.1 The Receiving Party shall use the Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and for no other purpose whatsoever.
3.2 The Receiving Party shall hold the Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall protect it using at least the same degree of care that it uses to protect its own confidential information of a similar nature, and in no event less than a reasonable degree of care.
3.3 The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information only to those of its Representatives who need to know it for the Purpose and who are bound by obligations of confidentiality no less protective than those contained in this Agreement. The Receiving Party shall be responsible for any breach of this Agreement by its Representatives.
3.4 The Receiving Party shall not copy, reverse engineer, decompile or disassemble any Confidential Information, software, prototype or other tangible item provided by the Disclosing Party, except to the extent strictly necessary for the Purpose.
3.5 The Receiving Party shall promptly notify the Disclosing Party in writing upon becoming aware of any unauthorised use or disclosure of the Confidential Information, and shall take all reasonable steps to limit its consequences.
3.6 Where the Confidential Information disclosed by Brightwater includes personal data of its customers, Pixelkraft shall process such personal data only for the Purpose, on the documented instructions of Brightwater, and in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

4. RESIDUAL KNOWLEDGE
4.1 Notwithstanding anything contained in this Agreement, nothing shall restrict Brightwater or its Representatives from using, for any purpose, any Residuals. "Residuals" means ideas, concepts, know-how and techniques contained in the Confidential Information of Pixelkraft that are retained in the unaided memory of the personnel of Brightwater who had access to such Confidential Information.

5. RETURN OR DESTRUCTION
5.1 Within five (5) days of a written request from the Disclosing Party, and in any event upon the expiry or termination of this Agreement, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party in its possession or control, including all copies, notes and extracts, and an authorised officer of the Receiving Party shall certify such return or destruction in writing.

6. TERM AND SURVIVAL
6.1 This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of two (2) years from the Effective Date, unless terminated earlier by either Party by giving thirty (30) days' written notice to the other Party.
6.2 The confidentiality obligations of the Parties under this Agreement shall survive the expiry or termination of this Agreement and shall continue in perpetuity.

7. NON-COMPETITION AND NON-SOLICITATION
7.1 During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its expiry or termination, Pixelkraft shall not, directly or indirectly, provide design, user experience or technology services to any person engaged in the business of online retail of apparel, footwear or home furnishings in India that competes with Brightwater.
7.2 During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months after its expiry or termination, neither Party shall solicit for employment or hire any employee of the other Party with whom it had contact in connection with the Purpose.

8. NO LICENCE, NO WARRANTY AND NO OBLIGATION TO PROCEED
8.1 All Confidential Information shall remain the property of the Disclosing Party. Nothing in this Agreement grants the Receiving Party any licence or right in respect of any Confidential Information, patent, copyright, trade mark or other intellectual property of the Disclosing Party, except the limited right to use it for the Purpose.
8.2 All Confidential Information is provided "as is", without any warranty, express or implied, as to its accuracy, completeness or fitness for any purpose.
8.3 Nothing in this Agreement obliges either Party to enter into any further agreement or business engagement, and either Party may terminate discussions relating to the Purpose at any time.

9. REMEDIES
9.1 The Receiving Party acknowledges that a breach of this Agreement may cause irreparable harm to the Disclosing Party for which damages may not be an adequate remedy, and that the Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief under the Specific Relief Act, 1963, in addition to any other remedy available to it.
9.2 In the event of any breach of this Agreement by Pixelkraft or its Representatives, Pixelkraft shall pay to Brightwater liquidated damages of Rs. 50,00,000/- (Rupees Fifty Lakh only) for each instance of breach, which the Parties agree is a genuine pre-estimate of the loss likely to be suffered by Brightwater and not a penalty.
9.3 Pixelkraft shall indemnify and keep indemnified Brightwater, its Affiliates and their respective directors and employees against all losses, damages, costs (including legal fees), claims and liabilities, including indirect and consequential losses and loss of profit, arising out of or in connection with any breach of this Agreement by Pixelkraft or its Representatives.

10. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
10.1 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.
10.2 Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to arbitration by a sole arbitrator to be appointed by Brightwater, in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The seat and venue of arbitration shall be Mumbai, and the language of the arbitration shall be English.
10.3 Subject to Clause 10.2, the courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction in relation to this Agreement.

11. GENERAL
11.1 This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions and understandings, whether oral or written.
11.2 Neither Party shall assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other Party, except that Brightwater may assign this Agreement to any of its Affiliates without such consent.
11.3 Neither Party shall use the name, logo or trade marks of the other Party in any publicity material, client list or announcement without the prior written consent of the other Party.
11.4 No failure or delay by a Party in exercising any right under this Agreement shall operate as a waiver of that right, nor shall any single or partial exercise of a right preclude its further exercise.
11.5 This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, and an electronically signed copy shall be treated as an original in accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000.
11.6 The stamp duty payable on this Agreement under the Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958 shall be borne by Pixelkraft.
11.7 Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be sent by email, with a copy by registered post, to the addresses of the Parties set out above or to such other address as a Party may notify in writing.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Parties have executed this Agreement through their duly authorised signatories on the Effective Date.
